item.description: Core prediction and health check endpoints

item.name: Drift Monitoring

request.description: Get the current status of drift monitoring for a specific zone. The API always evaluates the deployed champion model, so there's no need to select a model type. Returns the last time a check was executed, time remaining for the next window, and a summary of the latest report (if available).

response.name: Drift status response

originalRequest.description: Get the current status of drift monitoring for a specific zone. The API always evaluates the deployed champion model, so there's no need to select a model type. request.description: Log an actual observed value for drift monitoring. If `timestamp` is omitted, the API uses the current time. This enables comparisons between logged predictions and observed values to detect performance drift.
